answer.justification: dimension of momentum, mass times speed

distractors: dropping an exponent or inverting the denominator
prose: Consider the physical quantity defined as momentum, mass times speed. The dimensions of the inputs are: m: Mass, v: Length/Time.
question: What is the physical dimension of the resulting quantity?
reference_hml:
module DimensionDerivation

param q : Quantity[Mass * Length / Time]

check dimension q = Mass * Length / Time
